description: Land Acquisition - Kalapaluwawa, Kolonnawa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily focused on land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and locations for acquisition purposes. While it mentions a government minister (S. M. Chandrasena) issuing the order, the core content is overwhelmingly about land/property matters rather than government personnel or structural changes, making it a Land Gazette under Type 4.
